answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing escrowed tasks that require reciprocal, time-separated attestations from counterparties with established stake; a single agent cannot validate its own work. Random audits sample the sonnet, vine, or atlas task records, and fraud forfeits the escrow while honest attestations build reputation slowly. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many identities, keep them active, and recruit or control credible counterparties, tying up capital and risking it on each fake claim.
